description: We are designing a long-span floor for a municipal library under Part 4. The team proposes submitting strength and stability checks only. We would omit all serviceability-limit-state checks, including deflection and vibration, because the predicted member strength is ample. What must our alternative submission address?

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: Required serviceability-limit-state checks are omitted from the structural design.
gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
